title.suggested: Ben Hogan Training at the Wash Home Before the Allen Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat visited Ben Hogan at the Wash Home, where he was training with Jerry Donovan to meet Tom Allen a week later. Mike McCoole, it said, had fully recovered from his beating by Allen.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Tuesday, October 21, 1873'; masthead 'Daily Democrat'. Pre-1875 merger.

facts.fact: Allen's fight with Ben Hogan was set for October 28, 1873, one week from the date of the article

notes: Article is about Hogan; Allen appears as his upcoming opponent and in the McCoole aside.
